description.narrative: The project aims to provide safe water, and improved hygiene practices and facilities at the household level in areas ranked with severe problems with water availability and water access (Kafar Daael) in rural Aleppo. This targeted intervention will havea tangible wider impact across targeted communities, including on mothers and children who will not have to travel to and que at distributionpoint, on children who will not have to miss school to collect water, and on mothers who don’t have to leave other family members (perhaps with disability or young children) alone unattended at home to collect water. The project will also have positive impact on food security, nutritional status and health outcomes, since targeted communities would have a larger disposable income to spend on necessities other than water. 11000 individuals will have improved access to water as a result of repair and rehabilitation of watersystems. The existing water network is functional, however the pumping stations need to be rehabilitated including electrical, civil, and mechanical equipment as pumps, pipes, cables, panels etc. 5000 people (among the 11.000 population) will receive hygiene kitsto meet hygienic needs. The kits will contain: washing powder, toilet paper, soap, toothpaste, toothbrushes, shampoo, razor and shaving cream, hygiene pads, towels, nail cuter, table tissues, sponges and liquid soap for dishwashing. 5000 people (the same households receiving hygiene kits) will be reached by hygiene promotional activitiesand campaigns. Income sources of the people living in the target areas are almost not available as agriculture for example is not easily done under the current situation with lack of fuel and security situation. A lot of households work as employees in Aleppo City. The essential goods are covered by going to Aleppo city and buying from available markets. The overall goal is to improve the food security of the most vulnerable people in Jebel Samaan district through unconditional and unrestricted cash distribution. 3500 people benefitting from unconditional and unrestricted cash,assessed as most vulnerable, through local (vetted) Financial Service Providers. The project duration is 1 year (2021).

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Great Britain is a member of Oxfam International, a confederation of independent national organisations working in more than 90 countries. Oxfam works on six goals that support the shared vision of a just world without poverty: help people claim their right to a better life; champion equal rights for women; saving lives, now and in the future; safeguard global food supplies; help people claim a fairer share of natural resources; and increase money for basic services. For 70 years, Oxfam has been running emergency responses, development projects and campaigning at the grass roots level to tackle poverty.

Hritan water pumping station (with flow 80m3/hr), which provide clean water to 3900 beneficiaries, by two pipelines, one of them goes to Haramess village, while the other line goes to Hraytan elevated tank 300 m3.2. Kafer Naya water pumping station (with flow 19 m3/hr ), in addition to solar system installation for this pumping station to provide clean water for 15,000 beneficiaries there as a hard to reach area.In parallel with the pumping station rehabilitation works in the mentioned two areas above, OXFAM finalized the rehabilitation of water network there as well, in order to ensure the clean water is accessible for all beneificaries, and to ensure the comprehensive response for the communities."
